items.q: What should you remember about **Work on what makes time stand still**?
items.a: **Ramaswamy was okay at research but** never passionate; software creation + business impact at Google ads was the fit.

items.q: What should you remember about **Every job has its own excellence bar**?
items.a: first-time public CEO had to learn analyst relations; find people who know the role and get feedback (**job definition of excellence**).

items.q: What should you remember about **Reluctant leader, hands-on craft**?
items.a: **pride in knowing product details;** software engineering as craft; great products + competitive pricing = defensibility.

items.q: What should you remember about **$100B plan as forcing function**?
items.a: **audacious target (2007–8) seemed** absurd but drove ~5% quarterly query-monetization improvements that compounded.

items.q: What should you remember about **Mobile was existential**?
items.a: **desktop flatline + mobile** fraction monetization = five-year fight; smooth outside view, turbulence inside.

items.q: What should you remember about **Neeva's fatal bar**?
items.a: **needed 10× vs Google given** distribution disadvantage; built ~1×; AI later made 10× plausible (ChatGPT).

items.q: What should you remember about **Startup = belief + madness**?
items.a: **quasi-religious conviction you can do** what others haven't; failure still teaches; resilience > pure success.

items.q: What should you remember about **Snowflake AI bar**?
items.a: **faster, cheaper, better (ideally** all three); leverage best models into enterprise value creation.

items.q: What should you remember about **Identity anchor**?
items.a: **tell yourself and your kids**: more than successes *and* more than failures; cherish wins more after knowing how rare they are.
